items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: Clarence Williams I made a few with

ctx.x: Yeah, I understand he is. Well, he was the first one I made a record with. Yeah. Yeah. Then I -- well, all during this time I was making records here and there. Clarence Williams I made a few with, and other people, you know, who were, you know, small, you know.
Was that -- was that considered at that time, for instance when you were asked to do the first record, was that a very exciting thing, or was that just another job?
